syntax: Syntax guide: everything you can write
syntaxHint: Tap Add to put a line in your list.
voiceHint: Record your voice while you tap through the steps, so each bar or slice appears when you say it. Or add an audio file you already have. Your voice stays on your device.
voiceTapTitle: Recording: say it, then tap Next step
voiceReady: Tap Next step each time you move to the next number. The chart is empty until your first tap.
voiceBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow the microphone for this page, or add an audio file instead.
voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record from the microphone. Add an audio file instead.
voiceReadFailed: That audio could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
voiceTimed: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps follow the moments you tapped.
voiceFitted: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps are spread to fit it.
voiceChanged: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. You changed the number of steps after recording, so the steps are spread to fit the voice.
voiceFit: Spread the steps to fit the voice
voiceNoSound: This browser cannot put sound into the video. The video will be made without it. You can add your voice in your editing app.
fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
tip: Tip: save the video, then drop it into Instagram Edits, CapCut or InShot. If you added your voice here, the sound is already in the file.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or fewer steps, and keep this page open while it records.
endText: Words on the card at the end
textLabel: Type your numbers, one line per step
textHint: Each line is one step that appears in order. Write a label, a colon and a number, like Jan: 40. Add a note after a bar sign to show it on the card. Up to 50 steps.
empty: Write a first line above, for example: Jan: 40

typeHint.bar: Each line grows a bar, one after another. Good for months or a few groups.
typeHint.hbar: Bars that grow sideways, with the names on the left. Good for long names and rankings.
typeHint.line: A line that draws itself point by point. Good for growth over time.
typeHint.pie: Slices that sweep in, with a list of names and numbers. Good for shares of a whole.
typeHint.donut: A ring that fills slice by slice, with the total in the middle.
typeHint.race: Each line is one moment with a number for every name, like 2021: Ravi=100, Meena=80. The bars swap places as the numbers change.

countUp: Count the numbers up as the bars grow
grid: Show grid lines and side numbers
multi: A different colour for each bar
endPlaceholder: For example: 3 times more in four months
numbersHint: Put a sign such as ₹ or $ before the number, or % after it, and it shows on every number. An end: line in your numbers overrides the end card box.
credit: Use plain positive numbers. Commas are fine, so 1,20,000 works. The chart scales itself to your biggest number.

syntaxItems.title: A number for a label
syntaxItems.note: Each line is one step. Bars, lines, pies and donuts all use this.

syntaxItems.title: A note on the card
syntaxItems.note: Put a bar sign and some words after the number. They show on a card at the bottom while that step plays.

syntaxItems.title: Rupees, dollars and percent
syntaxItems.note: A sign in front or a percent sign after is fine, and commas too.

syntaxItems.title: A race with several names
syntaxItems.note: Choose the Race chart. Each line is one moment, with Name=number for every name.

syntaxItems.title: Words at the end
syntaxItems.note: Shown on a card when the chart finishes, after the highest one is highlighted.
syntaxItems.code: end: 3 times more in four months

syntaxItems.title: A pause
syntaxItems.note: Holds the picture for 2 seconds, or the number you write.

syntaxItems.title: A title
syntaxItems.note: Stays at the top of the video.
